standard-dialogue.npc: Hello I'm Luthas, I run the banana plantation here.

options.text: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?

steps.player: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?

steps.npc: Yes, I can sort something out. There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship.
You wouldn't believe the demand for bananas from Wydin's shop over in Port Sarim. I think this is the third crate I've shipped him this month..
If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.

options.text: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?

steps.player: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?

steps.npc: Well I know her pretty well. She doesn't cause me any trouble any more.
She doesn't even search my export crates any more. She knows they only contain bananas.

steps.player: Really? How interesting. Whereabouts do you send those to?

steps.npc: There is a little shop over in Port Sarim that buys them up by the crate. I believe it is run by a man called Wydin.

standard-dialogue-after-accepting-his-ta.npc: Have you completed your task yet?

options.text: What did I have to do again?

steps.player: What did I have to do again?

steps.npc: There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship. If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.

options.text: No, the crate isn't full yet.

steps.player: No, the crate isn't full yet...

steps.npc: Well come back when it is.

options.text: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?

steps.player: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?

steps.npc: I sell them to Wydin who runs a grocery store in Port Sarim.

options.text: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?

standard-dialogue-after-completing-his-t.player: I've filled a crate with bananas.

options.text: Will you pay me for another crate full?

steps.player: Will you pay me for another crate full?

steps.npc: If you go outside you should see the old crate has been loaded on to the ship, and there is another empty crate in its place.

options.text: Thank you, I'll be on my way

steps.player: Thank you, I'll be on my way.

options.text: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
